items.context: Kya aapko lagta hai ki outstanding balance sahi nahi hai?
items.text: bilkul galat charge hai
mera due amount baar baar badh raha hai kuch samajh nahi aata
mujhe lagta hai ki interest galat lagaya gaya hai is bill mein
payment kar diya tha par wo amount adjust nahi hua abhi tak
mere account mein transfer ho gaya tha paisa lekin update nahi hua
maine last month bhi payment ki thi phir bhi outstanding aaya hai
statement check karo mera payment receipt bhi bheja tha apke paas
account number 1234 5678 9012 ke upar yeh galti ho rahi hai

items.context: Kya payment transfer karne ke baad koi confirmation mila aapko?
items.text: transfer hua tha par payment confirm kyun nahi hua

items.text: aapne jo calculate kiya woh galat hai mera interest different hai

items.context: Aapke payment ka receipt aapke paas available hai kya?
items.text: maine 5000 rupees jama kiye the par dikh raha hai extra outstanding

items.context: Kya aapka account balance mein koi discrepancy lag rahi hai?
items.text: payment 12 april ko ki thi uske baad bhi balance clear nahi hua

items.context: Kya aap previous communication ke details share kar sakte hain?
items.text: maine apko message kiya tha mismatch ki wajah se ab tak jawab nahi aaya
maine ek mahine pehle payment ki thi par jo outstanding amount dikh raha hai wo galat lag raha hai kyunki maine full payment kiya tha us din
kal tak mujhe payment karna tha par mere account se do baar paisa kat gaya tha aur transfer nahi hua hai mujhe verify karna tha ki paisa kahan gaya
mera account number 9876 5432 1098 pe interest aur charges clear nahi hua hai jo bill hai wo duplicate lag raha hai kal se update karane ki koshish kar raha hoon

items.context: Kya aapne apne last payment ke baad account statement check kiya hai?
items.text: Aapko jo amount dikh raha hai kya wo last payment ke baad update hua hai mujhe samajh nahi aaya kyunki payment 5000 kiya tha phir bhi outstanding aa raha hai

items.context: Kya aap apna account number confirm kar sakte hain taaki hum verification karein?
items.text: Account number 1122 3344 5566 mein kuch missing transactions dikh rahe hain jinke wajah se mujhe galat balance bataya jaa raha hai main aapse request karta hoon ki verification karen

items.context: Kya aap hume payment ka proof bhej sakte hain taaki hum aapka case check kar saken?
items.text: Jo amount aapne charge kiya hai wo mere hisaab se galat hai maine pichle mahine advance payment ki thi to please mujhe iska breakdown samjhayen taaki main samajh saku ki charges kahan lag rahe hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: dispute_amount - says the outstanding amount or a charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
